name: Tera
source:
Mysterious loli that Abel and Fran rescue from variant nest.

Doesn't have any memories from the time before Fran found her, and start to call Fran mother whom takes Tera to live with her. Cheerfull good girl that quickly becomes idol like existance in Voromia Academy.
